test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct with respect to basketball?

options.text: Each team is made up of 11 players, with only 7 allowed on the court at any time.
Each team is made up of 12 players, with only 5 allowed on the court at any time.
Each team is made up of 11 players, with only 4 allowed on the court at any time.
Each team is made up of 12 players, with only 8 allowed on the court at any time.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Each team is made up of 12 players, with only 5 allowed on the court at any time. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In basketball, **each team typically has 12 players on the roster, i**ncluding substitutes.
 
• At any given time, **5 players from each team are allowed on the court to play.**
